{{ModBox}}
'''Rifle Ammo Mutation''' is an [[Assault Rifle Mods|assault rifle mod]] that converts any unused Secondary [[Ammo]] into Primary Ammo. The affected rifle will only convert ammo while equipped, and will '''not''' convert any ammo type used by [[holster]]ed secondary weapons until their own ammo is full.

Converted ammo is denoted by a {{Icon|Item|Mutate}} symbol. The final amount of ammo restored is rounded to the nearest integer.

|-
| 5 || 50.4% || 7

==Acquisition==
*This mod was originally awarded to players who participated in [[Operation Sling-Stone]].
*This mod is now available from [[Survival]] and [[Excavation]] missions.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Tips==
*Good for weapons with poor ammo economy, such as the {{Weapon|Grakata}}.
*Functions well with [[Sentinels|Sentinel]]'s {{M|Vacuum}} or {{Companion|Chesa Kubrow}}'s {{M|Retrieve}}, which automatically collect unused ammo as needed.

{{ModBox}}
'''Tainted Mag''' is a [[Corrupted Mods|Corrupted]] [[:Category:Assault Rifle Mods|assault rifle mod]] that increases [[magazine capacity]] while decreasing the [[Reload|reload speed]].

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! [[Magazine capacity]]
! [[Reload speed]]
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +6% || -3% || 4
|-
| 1 || +12% || -6% || 5
|-
| 2 || +18% || -9% || 6
|-
| 3 || +24% || -12% || 7
|-
| 4 || +30% || -15% || 8
|-
| 5 || +36% || -18% || 9
|-
| 6 || +42% || -21% || 10
|-
| 7 || +48% || -24% || 11
|-
| 8 || +54% || -27% || 12
|-
| 9 || +60% || -30% || 13
|-
| 10 || +66% || -33% || 14
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*This is an [[:Category:Assault Rifle|Assault Rifle]]-exclusive mod. It does '''not''' work with [[:Category:Bow|Bow]]s/Crossbows or [[:Category:Sniper Rifle|Sniper Rifle]]s.
*For any non-integer magazine values the magazine size is simply rounded to the nearest whole number. For example, a {{Weapon|Braton}} modded with a max rank '''Tainted Mag''' will have a calculated magazine size of {{Math|45 {{mul}} (1 + 66%)|t=y|bf-a=y}}, which will simply round to {{Math|75|round|0|bf-a=y}}.
*Note that due to the way Reload Speed is calculated, reduced reload speed has a more substantial effect on reload time than increased reload speed.
**For example, {{Weapon|Braton}} has a default reload speed of 2.0 seconds;
**With +30% reload speed from a rank 5 {{M|Fast Hands}}, the reload time would be 1.54 seconds, or a 23% reduction of reload time.
**With -30% reload speed from a rank 9 Tainted Mag, the reload time would be 2.85 seconds, or a ~29% increase of reload time.
**The two mods can be used together to counteract the reload speed penalty.
*Stacks with {{M|Magazine Warp}} and {{M|Wildfire}} for a total of 116% [[magazine capacity]].
*Stacks with {{M|Primed Magazine Warp}} (55%) and {{M|Wildfire}} (+20%) for a total of 141%  [[magazine capacity]].
*Despite being for assault rifles, '''Tainted Mag''' will work on launchers like the {{Weapon|Tonkor}} as well as semi-auto rifles like the {{Weapon|Latron}}.
*For [[:Category:Battery Weapons|Battery Weapons]] such as the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}} or {{Weapon|Fulmin}}, the reload time penalty only affects the reload delay and not the ammo regeneration rate. In other words, this mod will only increase the time before reloading starts.

==Trivia==
*This mod features [[Mag/Prime|Mag Prime]], which makes it absolutely pun-tastic.
